universe.claim_scope: historical anatomy/behaviour of the CURRENT constituent set
universe.survivorship: KNOWN · ACCEPTED · DECLARED — this is NOT a point-in-time historical S&P 500 universe

calendar.convention: BAR_START; lattice is left-closed so the session-close stamp is NOT a regular minute

expected_coverage_rule.definition: an expected regular minute exists iff the security is in the frozen 503, is REGULAR_WAY on that date per V6, XNYS defines a valid session, and the timestamp is one of that session's expected BAR_START slots
expected_coverage_rule.binding: expected coverage does NOT depend on whether the vendor returned data
expected_coverage_rule.why: folding source-access validity into eligibility would drop the five rename-boundary sessions out of the coverage domain — which would hide their uncertainty rather than resolve it

dimensions.rationale: these are orthogonal. A single flat enum invites downstream code to compare WHEN_ISSUED with UNOBSERVED and conflate them.

invariants: REGULAR_WAY_EXPECTED does not imply source access valid

source_completeness.level_proven: REQUEST — P6 established pagination exhaustion, zero duplicates, strict monotonicity, zero page-boundary gaps and identical replays
source_completeness.level_required: MINUTE EMISSION — that the vendor emits a bar for every minute in which a trade occurred
source_completeness.why_not: request-level completeness proves we received everything the vendor SENT. It does not establish what the vendor OMITS. P3 found the vendor omits no-trade minutes, but that is an inference from bar counts, not a guarantee — and P7 already showed vendor field quality is not uniform (vw outside [low,high] on 95/140 bars for an illiquid name).

structural_no_trade.consequence: absent expected minutes are UNOBSERVED with reason SOURCE_COMPLETENESS_UNPROVEN
structural_no_trade.rationale: a 100% correct UNOBSERVED is worth more than a tidy NO_TRADE we cannot prove. The definition is frozen so the state is available if an independent completeness source is ever qualified.
structural_no_trade.would_require: trade-level data or a second independent source
